messages:
Nora: who's up for an early Saturday surf or slow coffee + museum? low-key poll.
Ben: surf if it's not 50°F :sweat_smile:
Priya: coffee + museum for me — got tix to the Japanese prints exhibit.
Jackson: depends on the surf report. also, anyone driving? my bike's in the shop.
Li: I can drive 2 ppl. leaving 8:15? :car:
Emma: count me for museum. if surf, i'll be shore-side with espresso and heckling :sunglasses:
Ben: if surf, baker's beach? 6:30 meetup. anyone bringing boards?
Nora: i have one extra board and a towel. @Jackson you can grab it if needed.
Jackson: awesome, i'll take it if needed. also PSA: jamie left a half loaf of sourdough in the kitchen with a sticky note "for whoever needs carbs" :bread:
Jamie: guilty. it was a reward for surviving the deploy but sharing is caring. :grin:
Priya: love that — museum plan: cafe lumi 10:30, exhibit at 11? seems chill.
Ben: poll time — react with :one: surf, :two: museum, :three: sleep-in
Emma: two for museum (also three sounds tempting)
Li: one if swell is >3ft, otherwise two
Nora: i'm fine with either — if museum, can we make a stop at that new plant shop on 3rd? tiny succulents await.
Jackson: i'm team surf but low-energy so if no one wants to haul boards i'm down for museum.
Priya: plant shop stop yes. also quick reminder from calendar-bot: calendar-bot: "Don’t forget Friday 4pm office social in kitchen — snacks provided"
Ben: ooh snacks before weekend, perfect.
Nora: ok looks like museum edges ahead. final call: museum + coffee + plant-shop detour 10:30 @cafe-lumi. carpool: Li (2 seats) + Nora (1 extra board if needed).
Emma: tagging to confirm — see you saturday! :wave:
